9a719238ee.en: No production setup registered. Without one, the asset uses the reference productivity from the Asset tab, in {unit}/month.

e712315e43.es: Lo que cambió en la pestaña Activo todavía no se guardó. Cerrar descarta esos cambios.
e712315e43.en: What changed in the Asset tab has not been saved yet. Closing discards those changes.

0d10537c68.en: Quick asset registration. Depreciation, setups and costs are detailed in the asset window, which opens next.

a6199cf9ab.en: Each group total is the sum of priced items, pending items and items that have no cost yet.
